title: Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders: Carrier Attempts, Redelivery Fee and Returned Shipments
content:
Carrier and freight partner terms for Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, per fulfillment method. Each method includes a number of delivery attempts before the carrier returns the order to Tailwise; the redelivery fee is the fee for scheduling another freight delivery after the included attempts have failed.

| Fulfillment method | Delivery attempts before the carrier returns the order to Tailwise | Redelivery fee for another freight delivery | Fulfillment fee refunded when an undeliverable order comes back |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Ship-to-Home | 3 | $0.00 | No |
| Expedited Ship-to-Home | 3 | $0.00 | No |
| Buy Online Pick Up In Store | 0 | $0.00 | No |
| Curbside Pickup | 0 | $0.00 | No |
| Same-Day Delivery | 1 | $0.00 | No |
| Large Item Freight Delivery | 2 | $49.00 | No |

**Definitions**

- *Delivery attempts before return* - the count of delivery attempts the method includes; once that many attempts have failed, the carrier returns the order to Tailwise.
- *Redelivery fee* - the fee, in USD, for scheduling another freight delivery after the included attempts failed.
- *Fee refunded on return to sender* - whether the fulfillment fee is refunded when an undeliverable order comes back.

**Notes on the terms**

- Large Item Freight Delivery is the only method with a redelivery fee above zero, $49.00, and it includes 2 delivery attempts.
- The pickup methods include no carrier attempts (0), since the order is collected at the store or curb.
- No method refunds its fulfillment fee when an undeliverable order comes back to Tailwise.
